Hi Samantha — thanks, the agenda looks good. Quick note on timing: the week of Mar 8 there is a US daylight-savings jump — US clocks move forward earlier than EU. That creates a one-week window where a time labelled the same (e.g., 15:00 CET) will map to a different US local hour than it usually does.

We want to avoid people joining an hour off. Two quick options:
- Keep the session on Wed Mar 11 at 15:00 CET and we'll join at 10:00 ET (we'll confirm local times explicitly in the calendar invite).
- Or shift 1 hour earlier for the EU time (14:00 CET) so it lands at 09:00 ET, which is easier for our West Coast folks and for Marcus to cover APAC follow-up.

If you'd prefer, we can offer a tri-region bridge slot to make sure our APAC SME can join: Thu Mar 12 at 23:00 SGT / Thu 14:00 CET / Thu 07:00 PT (tight but possible). I've attached a quick timezone comparison chart for the week.

Let me know which you prefer and I'll send a calendar confirmation with explicit local times and the Google Meet link.
